issue.title: SenseNova turns Codex's structured-output requests away with guided_grammar compile_grammar_error — the refusal isn't recognized, the 400 reaches the client
issue.body:
SenseNova's backend refuses Codex's structured-output requests (thread_title, thread_description) with a 400 its own words don't let magpie recognize, so the error reaches the client and every title and description a session asks of a SenseNova-served model fails.

## What happens

Codex sends its title and description turns with structured output — `text.format` carrying a json_schema. A model served by SenseNova compiles that schema in its guided decoder and turns the request away:

```json
{"error":{"code":"400","message":"sensenova: guided_grammar '{\"$schema\":\"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema\",\"additionalProperties\":false,\"properties\":{\"description\":{\"minLength\":1,\"type\":\"string\"},\"title\":{\"maxLength\":36,\"minLength\":1,\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"title\",\"description\"],\"type\":\"object\"}' has compile_grammar_error: No module named 'xgrammar'","param":null,"type":"invalid_request_error"}}
```

The backend is missing the `xgrammar` module its guided decoding needs. The same refusal comes from SenseNova's own API (`token.sensenova.cn`) and from a litellm relay in front of it.

## Why magpie doesn't adapt

SenseNova's docs allow `response_format {"type":"json_object"}` only — the JSON shape is prompted, not enforced — so magpie's built-in refusal cascade (`refusesFormat` → json_object with the schema in the instructions → words alone) fits exactly. But the refusal's words name no format field at all (`guided_grammar`, `compile_grammar_error`), none of which the refusal regex matches, so the cascade never runs. models.dev also marks `sensenova-6.8-flash-lite` as `structured_output: true`, which the backend's own behaviour contradicts.

## Reproduce

Any `/v1/responses` request carrying `text.format` json_schema to a SenseNova-served model (verified on `sensenova/sensenova-6.8-flash-lite` against `token.sensenova.cn`, 2026-10-20).

## Verified fix

A build with `guided_grammar` and `compile_grammar` added to the `formatRefusal` regex self-heals against the real backend: the refused schema is asked again as a `json_object` with the schema in the instructions (200), the form is remembered, and later requests run pre-adapted. Unpatched, the same request 400s every time.

The change is on my fork with a test whose fixture is the refusal word for word, and the routing reference's structured-output bullet brought up to date with the two-step cascade:

- branch: https://github.com/jasonQin6/magpie/tree/sensenova-guided-grammar-refusal (commit be83af2)

Opening a PR from that branch is refused for my account ("jasonQin6 does not have the correct permissions to execute CreatePullRequest" — the REST endpoint 404s too), so this issue is pointing at it instead. Fetching the branch or applying the patch from it works; happy to do either differently if there is a preferred way.

## Environment

magpie gateway on Linux (vol-server build), Codex 0.163 as the client, SenseNova over its Responses endpoint; a routing group of free SenseNova-channel models serves the aux tasks.

comments.body:
Published a fix in my fork: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/8f931a28e570d616409753163fc93dc0fb3cfde5

The shared structured-output refusal matcher now recognizes `guided_grammar` and `compile_grammar` in 400/422 replies. This lets the existing cascade retry the refused schema as a JSON object with the schema preserved in the instructions, and pre-adapt subsequent requests after that form succeeds. Both passthrough and translated routes use this matcher. Other statuses and unrelated 400 errors keep their existing handling; no provider-specific model override or new retry mechanism was added.

Adapted from jasonQin6's be83af2f2674f6208e240f39fe70eb4f98066147, with co-author credit. I also added tests for each new wording independently and status controls (200/401/403/429/500/502 must not match), and updated the routing reference.

Regression evidence: keeping the new tests and restoring the old matcher returns the exact reported 400, and the new refusal-classification cases fail. With the fix, the format/schema-refusal test families pass together with `-race -count=5`; the handler test verifies the first retry, schema/instructions preservation, and the next request going straight to the accepted JSON-object form.

At this exact committed head, all seven acceptance checks passed with Go 1.26.8 and an isolated HOME: native/Linux/Windows vet and builds, plus `go test -tags nogui ./... -count=1 -timeout=45m` (69 packages passed). Combined branch: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/issue-batch-20261023-o

No live SenseNova account/API call was made: the local upstream fixture replays the report's error. Cross-OS vet/builds are not native Windows/macOS runtime checks. No upstream PR opened.

更新：下面的补丁替代本评论最初提出的“全局 invalid request 子串匹配 + 指数 cooldown”方案。复核后认为，短消息没有提供账户故障的证据，不应据此休眠 key/account。

补丁：https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/223f9b0a7ebfd9bc8edb8e004a875004c87f0786
分支：https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/bare-request-failover

**为什么这样修**

原路径会把没有明确原因的 `400 Invalid request` 直接返回客户端，错过同一请求由其他 member 成功处理的机会。但“是否换 member”“是否 cooldown”“cooldown 的范围”是三个不同判断。我们只为前者增加一条保守规则，不把未知原因归为账户故障或已确认的请求形状错误。

**具体行为**

- 仅新增处理 HTTP 400/422 的完整短 message：`Invalid request` 和 `inference request is invalid`，忽略大小写和两端空白。不是在整个 body 里搜索子串，也不匹配 `Invalid request parameters`、`Invalid request content: ...` 等带具体原因的消息。
- 在错误协议转换之前检查原始 body，支持顶层 `message`、`error.message` 及完整纯文本短消息。具体的 `code`、`type`、`param`、`detail` / `details` / `status` 会保留原有处理；通用错误封装不当作具体原因。已经被现有规则识别的错误也继续走原路径。
- 在尚未向客户端发送答复、且有下一候选时，沿现有路由尝试下一个 member。这个短消息本身不增加失败退避计数，不休眠 key、account 或 model；之后的新请求仍能使用原候选，包括同一 key 上的其他模型。
- 路由日志保留 `fail=other`，不误标为已确认的 `shape`。文本路由与 System One 决策组使用这条规则；共享的 `retryable()` 未扩大，图像/视频组不因本补丁改变。
- 保留 `tooLongUnsaid` 的上下文超长推断和原有最终错误选择逻辑。原评论所说“不会触发超长改写”“所有 member 失败后必然返回 400”不成立，应撤回。切换候选也不保证另一个 member 一定成功。

**有什么用**

当某个上游只给出上述模糊短消息，而另一候选能处理请求时，网关可以在这次请求内完成切换，减少客户端收到 400 后反复重试的机会；同时不会因为一份请求被拒绝而把可用账户或同 key 的其他模型一起休眠。补丁不声称解决了 NVIDIA / SenseNova 返回这条短消息的根因。

这与本 issue 较早的结构化输出修复 [8f931a2](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/8f931a28e570d616409753163fc93dc0fb3cfde5) 是两个独立改动：那一处识别 `guided_grammar` / `compile_grammar`，由现有逻辑改用另一种结构化输出格式；本次处理的是未说明原因的短消息，不能把两者混为同一个补丁。

**验证**

使用 Go 1.26.8、临时 HOME 和固定的 Go 缓存验证：

- 新增的 `TestBareRequest*` 与超长输入测试通过；同组测试 `-race -count=5` 通过。覆盖 Chat / Messages / Responses、stream 与非 stream、下一候选成功、后续请求仍使用原 key、同 key 的其他模型仍可用、具体错误不误匹配、候选耗尽及 System One 决策组。
- 反向验证：保留新测试，用 Go overlay 恢复上游的两个路由入口文件，测试因直接收到 400 而失败；单独移除不休眠分支，测试因记录了 `Rest` 而失败。这两次都是行为断言失败，不是编译失败。
- `gofmt` / `git diff --check`，native、Linux nogui、Windows 的 vet 和 build 均通过。
- **全量测试没有全绿。** 最终 `umask 0022` 下的 `go test -tags nogui ./... -count=1 -timeout=45m` 有 67 个包通过，4 个包失败，对应五个测试：`TestClaudeClientCacheAbsentUnchanged`、`TestPluginSOCKSProxy`、`TestNoCommandBypassesProc`、`TestTreeRSS`、`TestOpenCodeSessionOnEveryCall`。五项均在不含补丁的干净上游基线 `5e0d7c05` 上复现；最后一项在 OpenCode 测试族连续运行时复现，单独 `-race -count=20` 未复现。`TestTreeRSS` 在基线 `-race -count=20` 中失败 19 次。这些失败没有在本补丁中修复，不能据此宣称满足合并/发布的全量验收条件。
- 首轮另有两个权限测试受本机 `umask 0027` 影响；切到 `0022` 后在全量重跑中通过。

上述是本次补丁的验证结果，替代原评论中旧工作树的构建/测试记录。原先“当天共 9 次且全来自 NVIDIA”的计数也不再作为本补丁的证据。

没有调用真实 NVIDIA / SenseNova API；使用本地 HTTP fixture 验证路由行为。未部署到 docker1，未提交上游 PR。跨平台 vet/build 不等于在 Windows/macOS 上完成运行测试。

issue.title: gateway: a litellm relay's "'priority' is not supported for 'service_tier'" isn't recognised, so the 400 reaches Codex instead of the tier being dropped

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## Summary

A provider I added by its address (a litellm proxy, custom URL + key, no preset) refuses `service_tier`. magpie already has the right behaviour for that — it is supposed to drop the field, ask again, and remember it (`optionalFields` / `markUnfit`). It only fails to *recognise* litellm's wording, so the 400 goes straight to the agent.

Codex in the same setup then shows:

```
Relay: litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - 'priority' is not supported for 'service_tier' on this model.
Received Model Group=gpt-6.1-sol
Available Model Group Fallbacks=None
```

## Environment

- magpie 0.1.1330, macOS (arm64), the app (`/Applications/magpie.app`) serving the gateway on `127.0.0.1:3425`
- Agent: Codex (CLI), signed in to a ChatGPT account, `openai_base_url = http://127.0.0.1:3425/backend-api/codex`
- Provider: custom, `chat=https://relay.example.com/v1` + key (litellm in front of OpenAI models), models `gpt-6.1-sol`, `gpt-6-astra`
- Codex asks for Fast mode: `service_tier = "priority"` in `~/.codex/config.toml` (the same happens with `/fast` on in a session)

## Steps to reproduce

Any request that carries `service_tier`, on a Chat-translated turn to a provider that refuses it:

```sh
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/responses \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"relay/gpt-6.1-sol","input":"hi","service_tier":"priority"}'
```

Same with Codex: `service_tier = "priority"` in the config, a turn on `relay/gpt-6.1-sol`.

## Actual

One try, `service_tier` sent, the upstream 400 handed back to the client, nothing marked unfit — every later turn of the session fails the same way. `/v1/magpie/route` shows a single try:

```json
{"model":"codex/gpt-6.1-sol","tries":[{"id":"relay","model":"gpt-6.1-sol","status":400,"tier":"priority",
  "error":"Relay: litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - 'priority' is not supported for 'service_tier' on this model. …"}]}
```

The upstream body magpie receives (litellm's shape):

```json
{"error":{"message":"litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - 'priority' is not supported for 'service_tier' on this model. Received Model Group=gpt-6.1-sol\nAvailable Model Group Fallbacks=None","type":"invalid_request_error","param":null,"code":"400"}}
```

## Expected

The field is dropped, the request is asked again without it, and the provider is marked unfit for `service_tier` — exactly what already happens for e.g. `unsupported parameter: 'store'`. Fast mode stops at the ChatGPT-backend providers and the relay simply serves the request at its default tier.

## Why it isn't recognised

`refusedOptional` (`internal/gateway/gateway.go:5915`) walks the error text with these, and none of them match:

- `unknownOptionalField` (line 5939) — needs `unsupported parameter: 'x'`
- `unquotedUnsupportedOptionalField` (5940) — needs `unsupported parameter: x`
- `rejectedOptionalField` (5941) — needs `parameter 'x' is not supported`, i.e. the word `parameter`/`field`/`argument` before the quoted name
- `leadingRejectedOptionalField` (5947) — needs the message to *start* with `x is not supported`

litellm names the **value** first and the field after it: `'priority' is not supported for 'service_tier' on this model`. The message also starts with the provider name and the exception class (`litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - …`), so the `^…` pattern can't match either.

The call site is `gateway.go:5805`:

```go
if req.OwnTier && req.Tier != "" && slices.Contains(refusedOptional(res.StatusCode, b, body), tierField) {
```

`OwnTier` is true here (custom provider without a preset, `ir.go:203-210`), so the field is forwarded (`chat.go:522`, `responses.go:1289`) by design — the comment right there says "a relay of theirs may serve Fast and Ultrafast where magpie can't tell … one that turns the field away is asked again without it (`optionalFields`)".

## Proposed fix

One more pattern for a vendor that names the field after the value it turned away, plus the loop in `unsupportedOptionalField`:

```go
// valueRejectedForField is a vendor naming the field after the value it
// turned away: litellm's "'priority' is not supported for 'service_tier'
// on this model".
var valueRejectedForField = regexp.MustCompile("(?i)['\"\\x60][^'\"\\x60]{0,64}['\"\\x60]\\s+is\\s+(?:unsupported|not supported)\\s+for\\s+['\"\\x60]([a-z_]+)['\"\\x60]")
```

```go
for _, match := range valueRejectedForField.FindAllStringSubmatch(v, -1) {
    if match[1] == field {
        return true
    }
}
```

A test in `internal/gateway` (a fake upstream answering the body above) would assert: two tries, the second without `service_tier`, and `s.fits(p.ID, tierField, provider.Chat) == false` afterwards — e.g. `TestTierRefusedAfterTheValue`.

Happy to open the PR if you'd rather take it that way; I didn't want to send code for a behaviour you may have opinions about (dropping the tier on a relay that only refused one *value* of it, as `unsupported_value` deliberately doesn't).

## Workaround for anyone hitting it

- Client side: turn Fast off (`/fast` in Codex, or remove `service_tier` from `~/.codex/config.toml`).
- Relay side: litellm's `drop_params: true` (or add `service_tier` to the model's supported params).

Related: #1784 (recording `service_tier`), #2618 (the agent's own `service_tier: priority` still sending every request fast), #3035 (another refusal wording that isn't recognised).
